self_consistency: Three separately queued paths using distinct workers or isolated CLI sessions.
self_verification_cove: Verification prompts are constructed after all initial answers are recorded.
limitations: CLI sessions share context among up to eight items; persistent subagents can retain prior queue context.
The first 10 self-consistency path 1 items used a worker that had also answered some Normalize Then Solve prompts; the three self-consistency paths remained separate from one another.
The runtime does not expose a dated model snapshot, sampling controls, provider request IDs, random seeds, or token telemetry.
The matched control and Tier 1 methods are not time or order controlled.
